title: Pharmacy App
description: A mobile pharmacy app built with Xamarin and .NET MAUI, giving users access to their prescription history and prescription refills.
summary: Prescription history and refills, closer at hand.
overview: The app brings prescription history and refill requests to a phone, helping users access these services when they need them.

title: WellData™ MobileRT
description: WellData™ MobileRT is a Xamarin Forms application for monitoring drilling rig information in real time.
summary: Drilling rig information, monitored in real time.
overview: WellData™ MobileRT presents drilling rig information on a mobile device. Its screens bring real-time operational data and charts together.

title: Sharp Remote
description: A personal TV remote project that sends commands over WebSockets and stores custom buttons in SQLite.
summary: The kids lost the remote. I built an app.
overview: After my kids kept losing the TV remote, I built a remote for a phone. WebSockets send commands to the TV, while a SQLite database stores custom buttons.

title: Glacier Melt
description: An interactive dashboard exploring illustrative glacier retreat and meltwater data from 1990 to 2024.
summary: An interactive exploration of illustrative glacier data.
overview: Select a year to explore the glacier illustration, runoff indicators, and data table. The dashboard uses illustrative calculations, rather than live monitoring or actual satellite imagery.

title: News Explorer
description: A responsive news-interface demonstration featuring sample articles, expandable previews, saved items, and simulated updates.
summary: Sample stories, saved articles, and simulated updates.
overview: Browse sample stories across Politics, Tech, and Sports, expand article previews, and save items locally. New sample articles are inserted every 20 seconds to demonstrate dynamic content; this is not a live news feed.

title: Newsletter Archive
description: A responsive newsletter archive with search, category and tag filters, date ranges, saved items, and reading previews.
summary: Find, filter, save, and read sample newsletters.
overview: Explore a local sample newsletter collection with combined search and filters, date ranges, and sorting. Save newsletters in your browser, preview their contents, or open the full reading view.
